title: Shape planned-change file (shape-changes.yml), version 1
description: A reviewable list of changes that are planned for a feed, kept in git next to shape.yml. `shape diff`, `shape check` and `shape verify` read it: a change inside its window is reported as planned and does not fail, a suppressed one is not reported, and an expired entry stops matching. The file is YAML (JSON works too). Rules the schema language cannot state are enforced by `shape changes validate`: ids are unique and match [a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*, kinds are drift kinds (docs/DRIFT.md) or contract rules, dates are real calendar dates, `until` is not before `from`, and `severity` goes with (and only with) the severity action.

version.description: The format version. A file with a newer version than the installed Shape understands is refused.

source.description: A source name from shape.yml. Without it the entry applies to every source.

column.description: A column name, table.column or a glob; * for every column and for table-level kinds.

kinds.description: Drift kinds (docs/DRIFT.md) or contract rule names.

from.description: ISO date (UTC), inclusive. Without it the entry is active from the beginning.

action.description: expect (default): reported as planned, not failing. suppress: not reported. severity: reported with `severity`.

class.description: Optional. The change class (docs/DRIFT.md, Change classes) of the changes this entry matches, instead of the class of their kind. A file without it reads as before.
